h-sbs-equal.note: Y1: all-same report -> zone width 1 (` = ` once), single block rule

h-sbs-insert.note: Y2: one inserted byte -> orphan slot keeps row positions; `<>` zone width 2

h-sbs-append.note: Y3: right-only rows with a blank left column, `<>` once at the boundary

h-sbs-delete.note: Y4: left-only row; the block rule uses the GLOBAL max width (70)

h-sbs-many.note: Y5: marker text only on each block's FIRST row

h-int-insert.note: Y6: diff rows split per side; merged same rows carry both offsets

h-sum-diff.note: Y7: same + difference lines only, in the measured order

h-int-title.note: V3: interleaved title replaces frame line 1; the last block emits all left rows before the right line (V3 block ordering)
h-int-title.title: HexIntTitle

h-int-600.note: Z7: offsets stay 8 hex digits past 0xFFFF

h-sbs-600.note: Y12: 600-byte pair, first changed row at 0x258

h-sbs-empty-left.note: Y13: empty side collapses its column; ` <> ` then the right field

h-sbs-title.note: Y11: title replaces frame line 1; a same+orphan leftover row is ONE block
h-sbs-title.title: HexTitle

h-sum-mixed.note: V5: all four count categories (m70e2, both installs): 56/31/1/1
